Your AI-written posts have tells, and people can spot them: "It's not just X, it's Y." "Let that sink in." "Here's the thing."

Humanizer rewrites AI text so it sounds like a person wrote it, without changing what it says. 59.7K stars.

It's built on Wikipedia's "Signs of AI writing", the guide Wikipedia editors use to catch AI-generated text. It checks 26 patterns, including the five most common:
→ "Not X but Y"
→ one-line closers like "Let that sink in"
→ sayings that sound deep but say nothing
→ staged run-ups like "Here's the thing"
→ arguing with someone who never spoke

In a blind test, judges preferred its rewrite over the original AI text 16 times out of 16.

Claude Code:
/plugin marketplace add blader/humanizer
/plugin install humanizer@humanizer

Any other agent:
npx skills add blader/humanizer --global --agent '*'

It also works in https://t.co/Jy5TbgcpMx: download the repo as a ZIP and upload it as a skill.
